label: 01-bronze.sql:1
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bronze.lakehouse

label: 01-bronze.sql:2
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS silver.lakehouse

label: 01-bronze.sql:3
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS gold.lakehouse

label: 01-bronze.sql:4
sql: SET SESSION bronze.compression_codec = 'ZSTD'

label: 01-bronze.sql:5
sql:
CREATE TABLE bronze.lakehouse.part WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT partkey, brand, type, size FROM tpch.sf1.part

label: 01-bronze.sql:6
sql:
CREATE TABLE bronze.lakehouse.partsupp WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT partkey, suppkey FROM tpch.sf1.partsupp

label: 01-bronze.sql:7
sql:
CREATE TABLE bronze.lakehouse.supplier WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT suppkey, comment FROM tpch.sf1.supplier

label: 02-silver.sql:1
sql: SET SESSION silver.compression_codec = 'ZSTD'

label: 02-silver.sql:2
sql:
CREATE TABLE silver.lakehouse.eligible_supplier WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT suppkey FROM bronze.lakehouse.supplier
WHERE suppkey IS NOT NULL AND comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'

label: 02-silver.sql:3
sql:
CREATE TABLE silver.lakehouse.part_supplier WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT p.partkey, ps.suppkey, p.brand, p.type, p.size
FROM bronze.lakehouse.part AS p
JOIN bronze.lakehouse.partsupp AS ps ON p.partkey = ps.partkey
JOIN silver.lakehouse.eligible_supplier AS s ON ps.suppkey = s.suppkey
WHERE p.brand <> 'Brand#45'
  AND p.type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
  AND p.size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)

label: 03-gold.sql:1
sql: SET SESSION gold.compression_codec = 'ZSTD'

label: 03-gold.sql:2
sql:
CREATE TABLE gold.lakehouse.q16_supplier_counts WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT brand, type, size, count(DISTINCT suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM silver.lakehouse.part_supplier
GROUP BY brand, type, size

label: 03-gold.sql:3
sql:
SELECT brand, type, size, supplier_cnt
FROM gold.lakehouse.q16_supplier_counts
ORDER BY supplier_cnt DESC, brand, type, size
